title: The Swan Accuses Orin
content: The public message names Orin Vale, but the pressure marks suggest a prearranged writing action rather than a genuine prophecy or spontaneous accusation.

title: Blackout from the Security Alcove
content: The lamps were cut from a concealed lever near the hired security post, not by a general power failure elsewhere in the house.

title: Lady Quince's Financial Peril
content: Lady Quince had a strong reason to dread a failed demonstration, making her appear suspicious, but the ledger also supports her presence in public view during the crucial minute.

title: Locked Room Faked by Wire
content: The workroom was not proof that the inventor vanished alone; the latch could be set from the corridor after someone removed him through another route.

title: Removable Message Cylinder
content: The swan's writing was governed by a removable cylinder, so a forged accusation could be installed before the demonstration by someone with access or a duplicate part.

title: Pip's Oil Rag Is Misleading
content: Pip handled the swan earlier, but the oil timing points to scheduled maintenance rather than the blackout interval.

title: The Message Could Not Be Composed Live
content: Professor Morcant confirms that the swan cannot reason, improvise, or identify a culprit; it can only execute mechanical instructions prepared in advance.

title: Rusk Claims the Canal Gate Stayed Locked
content: Captain Fen states that no one used the private canal gate during the blackout and that he personally checked it afterward.

title: Security Bootprint at the Hatch
content: A canal-security bootprint links the service hatch to recent dock use, contradicting the claim that the gate remained untouched.

title: Officer's Lock-Knot on the Rope
content: The rope was tied with a canal officer's silent-launch knot, indicating an official boat or officer's hand was involved in the inventor's removal.

title: R. Fen Ordered a Blank Cylinder
content: A blank swan cylinder was ordered in Captain Fen's name before the gala, providing the means to install the false accusation against Orin.

title: The Inventor's Ledger Names Fen
content: The hidden ledger gives Fen a motive: the inventor had documented a canal-security smuggling scheme and intended to expose it once his investors were assembled.
